# Sonos favorites

Plays a **Sonos favourite** on a `media_player.*` from a list on the dashboard.

<div class="widget-previews">
<figure><a href="../img/gallery/sonos_favorites_glow.png"><img src="../img/gallery/sonos_favorites_glow.png" alt="Sonos favorites, Glow style" loading="lazy" width="280" height="240" style="width: 224px"></a></figure>
</div>

## Entities

| Entity | Domains |
| --- | --- |
| Sonos player | `media_player.*` |
| Favorites sensor | `sensor.sonos_favorites` |

## Requirements

The **[Sonos integration](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/sonos/)** with its favorites sensor.

## Options

No options beyond the entities; the controls follow what the entity supports.

## On the panel

- The favourites as rows, in one or two columns by name length.
- A tap on a favourite plays it directly.

## Size

- Minimum: **280 × 240 px**.
- Maximum: **dashboard width × dashboard height**, capped by the display's dashboard area.

The minimum is a validation limit, not a recommended size. [Choose your display](../choose-display.md) lists the dashboard geometry; [Widget anatomy](../widget-anatomy.md) explains spacing and touch targets.
